page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, mixing Latin with Hebrew and Syriac/Greek words; running head at top; page number at top left; signature at foot centre. Show-through from the reverse page appears faintly in the right half and is left out.

main_text.p: פוּר Sors. Plur. פּוּרִים, פּוּרִיָא. Usus ejus solùm in historia Esther, & scribunt interpretes esse vocabulum Persicum.
פּוּשׁ Ch. Fructuosum esse, crescere, multiplicari: Syr. verò, Manere, remanere, quâ significatione etiam apud Talmudicos in usu. Aphel אַפְּישׁ Ch. Fecundum reddere, fœcundare, multiplicare.
פּוּז פּוּז Ch. Aurum solidum. Plur. emph. מָאנֵי פּוּזַיָּא Vasa aurea, auri solidi, Jobi 28.18. Hebr. פַּז.
פּוּזַר Hebr. Dispergere. Hinc Part. Pahel Chald. מְפַזֵּר Dispergit, Prov.20.8.
פָּחַד Ch. Pavere, expavescere. Part. וּתְהֵי פָּחִיד Erisq; pavens, Deut.28.66.
פַּחֲרִין Ch. Testes, testiculi, Levit.21.20. in Jon. Hebr. פַּחֲרִים.
פַּחָה פַּחֵי Vide infrà in פחם.
פַּחַת, פַּחֲרָא Ch. Dux, Princeps. Plur. fœminin. פַּחֲוָתָא Duces.
*פַּחַז Ch. Saliit, subsiliit, Deut.32.15. in T. Jon.
פַּסְנוּתָא Syr. Impudicitia, Salacitas, Lascivia, 2.ad Cor.12.21. ad Eph. 4.19. Graec. ἀσέλγεια.
פַּחַח פַּחִיחַ, פַּחִיחָא Ch. Nudus, Laceris vestibus indutus, Plur. פַּחִיחִין.
פַּחַם Syr. Æquare, comparare, conferre, Lucæ 2.19. 2. ad Corinth. 10.12. & 1.Ep. c.12. 13. Hinc Ch. לָא פַּחִים לֵיה Non æquiparatur ei, Prov. 3.15. Sic quoque legendum cap.8.11. pro פַּחִי.
פַּחֵימָא Ch. Similiter, pariter, Esth.3.3. in T. Sec.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are reproduced as far as legible; several vocalised Hebrew/Syriac forms are approximate and may contain errors. The Greek word ἀσέλγεια is uncertain.
